Fine low bright-green wheat blades between brown early-spring furrows; slightly fuller in April but not a modern tall crop. March: wet umber, straw ochre, ash gray and almost bare branches; April: translucent buds, pale wheat green and damp soil; May: modest leaf-out and richer wheat greens, still avoiding midsummer lushness.
special_rules: Visual variant of Open Wheat Field, not an additional income-producing terrain class.
authenticity_note: Overwintered wheat provided early green growth in cultivated Valley fields.
placement_status: GENERAL PERIOD TYPE; exact placement source-required
